entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling because I'd like to return a pair of cycling shoes I bought about a month ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?
It's a fit issue. I've tried to make them work, adjusted the cleats a few times, but they're just not right for my feet. I went on one long ride and they gave me terrible blisters.

I'm sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order information. Okay, I see you purchased the shoes 35 days ago. That's no problem at all.
So I can still return them?

Absolutely. Our policy for standard items like these cycling shoes allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that window, I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you.

Okay, that's great news. I appreciate that. Now, since I'm getting a refund but will still need a new pair, and I have to go through the hassle of shipping these back, is there any chance you could provide a small discount code for my next VeloFit purchase?

I understand your request. While I can't offer an additional discount code for a standard return, I can assure you the full refund will be processed as soon as we receive the item. I've just initiated the return in our system, and you'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes.
Alright, fair enough. A prepaid label and a full refund is a good resolution. I appreciate your help, David.

You're very welcome. Once you've sent the shoes back, you should see the refund credited to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can help you find a better-fitting pair of shoes soon. Have a great day.
